---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement to dctx
---

## Problem and workflow

What task are you trying to complete, and what is difficult today? Check existing
issues and the [roadmap](https://github.com/Eris-Margeta/dctx/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md#31-roadmap-and-acceptance-gates) first.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-visible result, with an example command or input/output if
helpful. Distinguish a new proposal from an already specified feature.

## Alternatives and impact

What workarounds did you consider? Describe compatibility, output determinism,
privacy, performance or plugin capability implications where relevant.

## Validation

How could a maintainer tell that the improvement works? Use synthetic examples
and omit confidential data.
